config.general.scanintervalseconds.name: Scan Interval (Seconds)
config.general.scanintervalseconds.desc: Interval in seconds between background equipment scans and warning evaluations.
config.setups.monitorsetup1.name: Monitor Mobile Plants (Tier 2)
config.setups.monitorsetup1.desc: Enables warnings for detected mobile wash plants in the Warning HUD.
config.setups.monitorsetup2.name: Monitor Setup T3-T5
config.setups.monitorsetup2.desc: Enables warnings for the stationary setup (Shakers, Trommels, Duplex Jigs / Gravel Pumps).
Includes automatically assigned hoppers and conveyors into Setup T3-T5 overall status.
config.setups.monitorsetup3.name: Monitor Setup T6 (Orange Beast)
config.setups.monitorsetup3.desc: Enables warnings for the Orange Beast in the Warning HUD.
Includes automatically assigned hoppers and conveyors into Orange Beast overall status.
config.setups.monitorgeneratorswitchbutt: Include individual socket breaker buttons on the big power generator in wear and breakdown alerts. Disabled by default to prevent HUD clutter.
config.thresholds.matwarningthreshold.de: Mat fill percentage threshold to trigger an attention warning.
config.thresholds.vehiclelowfuelthreshol: Fuel percentage threshold to trigger a low fuel warning for active machines.
config.thresholds.componentwearwarningth: Equipment part durability threshold to trigger an early wear warning before total breakdown.
config.warninghud.hudenabled.name: Enable Warning HUD
config.warninghud.hudenabled.desc: Toggles the on-screen overlay for plant and equipment warnings.
config.warninghud.hudonlyshowwarnings.de: Automatically hides the HUD when all equipment and mats are operational.
config.warninghud.hudcompactmode.name: Compact HUD Mode
config.warninghud.hudcompactmode.desc: Renders the HUD as an ultra-compact single line badge.
config.warninghud.hudmaxwidth.name: HUD Maximum Width
config.warninghud.hudmaxwidth.desc: Maximum width of the warning HUD window.
config.warninghud.hudmaxheight.name: HUD Maximum Height
config.warninghud.hudmaxheight.desc: Maximum height of the warning HUD window.
config.fuel.showfuelinvehicleswitcher.de: Displays fuel fill percentage directly inside the vehicle quick-switching bar.
config.debug.enabledebuggroup.name: Enable Diagnostic Inspector
config.debug.enabledebuggroup.desc: Enables detailed raw object inspection and claim dumping (toggle with F3).
